reasons.reader_question: The question is sharp and stated on the page: what Neela will answer, in the open, at the dusk before the assault.
reasons.change: Power goes public: Neela won't kneel, seats Janu, chooses the open answer. She now knows the queen's honest arithmetic and the two-night clock.
reasons.romance_movement: New reason: the household watches Devan stay silent while his office is offered. The wrist touch shows his choice was for her.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Hand back along the bench, thumb on the blister, 'wide advice' banter. Responsive and private under public eyes, with no narration.
reasons.character_logic: The queen is credible and never a strawman. 'The bundle your husband carried' gives her knowledge with no stated source.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Answering in front of the realm risks the spears and the pass. The deadline is two nights, and the queen's fondness makes refusal costly.
reasons.prose: Many 'did not' negations, a recap line of what Neela already heard, a vague 'kitchen servant' reference, a soft final sentence and a ch21 phrase echo.
reasons.continuity: 'Forty-two odiyans' stand in the court while Neela, one of the 42 (F740), is on the roof. 'For a year' at the newel overstates her tenure.

fixes: Continuity. 'forty-two odiyans, in their own mud-coloured cloth': Neela is one of the 42 and stands on the roof, so change it to 'forty-one of the Company'. 'She had gone round the parrot newel for a year' overstates her time at the fort; change it to 'since her first week' (F449, F514).

Ending. 'counted two nights, and found the number was not very large' is a reflective fade, not a reveal or an interrupted action. End on the queen's 'It is the cruelest thing about me.' Then add one concrete act that makes the next chapter necessary: Neela goes down to the court and calls the Company by the ram's horn (F898) to tell them the dusk.

Prose and recap. 'the same hand that had let a kitchen servant's name stay in her memory for six months' points to nothing on the page; tie it to Parukutty's cough, just witnessed. Cut 'Your warden told me at the gate that he holds a paper', since Neela heard it. Trim three of the 'Neela did not' negations to vary the rhythm.
reader_question: What will Neela answer in front of the whole realm at the dusk before the assault, and will Devan's reading of the writ cost them the spears?
new_facts_assessment: The Kolathur fair adds texture, is harmless and matches F919. Lata on the shelf matches F883. The queen learning the eleventh step from Rema's roll fits Eravi's confession (F596-598) and is needed. Unsourced: the queen naming 'the bundle your husband carried up and down my hills'. Give a source (Ittan's effects, Muthu's post) or make it an inference.
